newsitem.title: FRANCE: Exporter bids for durum wheat with tax in France.
newsitem.headline: Exporter bids for durum wheat with tax in France.

text.p: One exporter has applied via France to export a marginal 2.4 tonnes of durum wheat at a daily tax of 10 Ecus per tonne, France's grain office ONIC said on Wednesday.
The bid was placed on September 16, it said. The European Commission has three days to decide whether to accept or reject the bids.
The European Union voted last Thursday to scrap the daily 10 Ecus per tonne tax that applied since mid-July to soft and durum wheat exports.
A regulation abolishing the tax will be published on September 20 or September 23, EU sources have said.
